Name: Earthworm Jim
Description: Gameloft's handheld remake of the 1994 run-and-gun platformer. Blast, whip and bungee Jim through New Junk City, Buttville and the asteroid races in his super suit, taking on Billy the Bin, J. Alfred Maggot and Psy-Crow.
